_readme: Manual corrections layered on top of data/runewords.json, for cases
where our extracted game-data folder (a 'Reign of the Warlock' mod
snapshot, patch version unknown/untagged) has been confirmed wrong
against the actual live game (in-game Chronicle, or another verified
source) -- see the 2026-08-07 Coven investigation for how a
discrepancy like this gets found: our local runes.txt, its vendor
JSON copy, and our extracted-folder JSON all matched each other but
disagreed with live D2R, with no local file able to explain why.
Add one entry per runeword, keyed by its `id` field from
data/runewords.json (NOT its display name, which varies by locale).
Each entry can set `addStats` (new properties missing from our data),
`replaceStats` (matched by `code`, overwrites an existing wrong
value), and/or `removeStatCodes` (codes to drop entirely, for the
opposite problem -- a property we show that doesn't really exist).
Always record `verifiedAt` and `source` so a future check knows how
trustworthy/recent the override is.
Applied in src/lib/grail/applyRunewordOverrides.ts, wired into
src/app/[locale]/items/runewords/page.tsx -- data/runewords.json
itself is left untouched; this file is the single place corrections
accumulate over time without needing to hand-edit the bulk data file.
